description: Check the FORM of a VAT number against the published structure for its country: the prefix (AT, BE ... SK, EL for Greece, XI for Northern Ireland goods), the length and which characters go where. Send vat_number (one, with its two-letter country prefix; spaces and hyphens are ignored) or vat_numbers (up to 200, for a customer or supplier list). Get back, per number, the country, whether the form is right, the form it should have and why it is wrong (wrong length, wrong characters). This says nothing about whether the number is registered: it never asks VIES, and a number with the right form can still be unissued. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/vat-number-format). Not legal, tax or financial advice.

vat_number.description: One VAT number with its two-letter country prefix, for example DE811128135. Spaces and hyphens are ignored.

vat_numbers.description: Up to 200 VAT numbers to check in one call.

items.description: A VAT number with its country prefix.
